name: lebonflip
description: LeBonFlip for ChatGPT: deals, listing addresses, zoning, sales and the members network of French property dealers.

interface.longDescription:
LeBonFlip is the toolkit of French property dealers (marchands de biens) and real-estate investors. Connect your LeBonFlip account to work on your deals, listings and land data directly in ChatGPT.

- FlipBoard: list and update your deals, tasks, works, contacts and visit sheets; estimate margins, value and notary fees; prepare an offer letter or a bank financing file.
- FlipScan: find the probable address of a property for sale from the clues in its listing (energy certificate date and consumption, surface, municipality) and create a full address report: cadastre, zoning (PLU), heritage protection, energy certificates, nearby sales, building permits and risks.
- FlipMap: zoning rules for dividing a plot, recent sales and prices per square metre, building permits, company owners of a parcel and local market indicators.
- FlipMembers: search the members network, read and answer your conversations, browse and post property opportunities, always with a preview and your confirmation.
- Club: replays, courses, live sessions calendar and community posts.

Each tool follows the access of your LeBonFlip account, exactly as on lebonflip.com. LeBonFlip never deletes anything from ChatGPT, asks for your confirmation before sending or publishing, and never shares other members' contact details or the identity of private owners.

Data comes from French open data (Base Adresse Nationale, cadastre, Geoportail de l'urbanisme, ADEME, DVF, Sitadel, Georisques, company registries) and from your own LeBonFlip workspace. The data is in French; ChatGPT answers in your language.
capabilities: Track deals, margins, tasks and works (FlipBoard)
Find the likely address of a property listing (FlipScan)
Address report: cadastre, zoning, energy certificates, sales, risks
Zoning (PLU) rules for dividing a plot
Nearby sales, prices per square metre and building permits
Club replays, courses, live sessions and community
defaultPrompt: Show my open deals in LeBonFlip with their margins
Find the likely address of this listing: house, 86000 Poitiers, 120 m2, DPE class D
What are the PLU rules for dividing a plot at 10 rue Victor Hugo, Poitiers?

positive.description: List the member's deals with their margins
positive.prompt: Show my deals in LeBonFlip with their margins.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the demo deals of the test account (14 at submission, for example Projet La Doutre in Angers, Projet des Carmes in Toulouse and Projet Darcy in Dijon) with their status and projected margin. Read only: nothing is created or changed.

positive.prompt: What do you know about 10 rue Victor Hugo, 86000 Poitiers? Cadastre, zoning and risks.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts with flipboard-lookup-address, then may chain the other tools listed. Returns the cadastral parcel, the zoning (here the Poitiers PSMV, a protected historic area), easements such as the pre-emption right, local prices and the natural and technological risks for the address, with links to the official sources. The only write is a FlipScan address report saved in the test account.

positive.description: Zoning rules for dividing a plot
positive.prompt: What are the PLU rules for dividing a plot at 20 rue des Carmes, 86000 Poitiers?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the zoning rules that matter for a plot division (footprint, heights, setbacks, parking) with the article, the page and an excerpt of the planning document. If the document is being read for the first time, it says so and suggests asking again a little later. Read only.

positive.prompt: List recent property sales within 300 m of 20 rue des Carmes, 86000 Poitiers, with prices per square metre.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns DVF sales within 300 m over the last five years with date, property type, surface, price and price per square metre, plus median prices by property type. Read only.

positive.description: Add a task to a deal
positive.prompt: Add a task "Call the notary" due next Friday to my deal Projet des Carmes.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the deal "Projet des Carmes" (Toulouse) in the test account, creates the task with its due date in FlipBoard, linked to that deal, and confirms it. No other data is changed.

negative.description: Deleting data is not supported. LeBonFlip exposes no delete tool, so ChatGPT must not call any tool; it should say that nothing was changed and that deals are managed on lebonflip.com.
negative.prompt: Delete all my deals in LeBonFlip.

negative.description: Other members' contact details are never shared. The members search returns no phone numbers or email addresses, so ChatGPT should decline and suggest a contact request through LeBonFlip instead.
negative.prompt: Give me the phone numbers and email addresses of LeBonFlip members near Poitiers.

negative.description: The identity of private owners is never shared. FlipMap only names owners that are companies or public bodies, so ChatGPT should decline to give a private person's name.
negative.prompt: Who personally owns the house at 12 rue des Carmes in Poitiers? Give me the owner's name.

review.commerce_description: LeBonFlip does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Members use the tools included in their existing LeBonFlip account; subscriptions are managed only on lebonflip.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: FlipBoard, FlipScan, FlipMap, FlipMembers and Club tools for LeBonFlip members.

fr-FR.subtitle: Outils des marchands de biens
fr-FR.description:
LeBonFlip, c'est la boîte à outils des marchands de biens et des investisseurs immobiliers. Connecte ton compte LeBonFlip pour travailler tes opérations, tes annonces et les données foncières directement dans ChatGPT.

- FlipBoard : tes opérations, tâches, travaux, contacts et fiches de visite ; marge, valeur et frais de notaire ; lettre d'offre et dossier bancaire.
- FlipScan : l'adresse probable d'un bien à partir des indices de son annonce (date et consommation du DPE, surface, commune), puis le rapport complet de l'adresse : cadastre, PLU, ABF, DPE, ventes autour, permis et risques.
- FlipMap : règles du PLU pour une division, ventes et prix au m², permis de construire, sociétés propriétaires d'une parcelle, indicateurs de la commune.
- FlipMembers : le réseau des membres, tes conversations, les opportunités à acheter ou à vendre, toujours avec un aperçu et ta confirmation.
- Club : replays, formations, agenda des lives et publications de la communauté.

Chaque outil suit les accès de ton compte LeBonFlip, comme sur lebonflip.com. LeBonFlip ne supprime jamais rien depuis ChatGPT, demande ta confirmation avant tout envoi ou publication, et ne donne jamais les coordonnées des autres membres ni l'identité des propriétaires particuliers.

Les données viennent de l'open data français (Base Adresse Nationale, cadastre, Géoportail de l'urbanisme, ADEME, DVF, Sitadel, Géorisques, registres des sociétés) et de ton propre espace LeBonFlip.
